facts.text: The question is whether a retaining wall on two properties complies with B1 after strengthening and additions, and whether an associated surface-water system complies with E1.
A building consent for a new dwelling at 52A Jackson Terrace was issued in November 2017; its documents did not show the original retaining wall on the eastern boundary.
Figure 3 is a structural engineer's detail for the strengthening and addition to the original wall.
Figure 4 shows the surface-water dish channel falling from two directions; Figure 5 shows separation of the channel.
The structural engineer provided a Producer Statement - Construction Review ("PS4") for the retaining wall work.
